verdict.rationale: Browser Use's own examples show agent tasks that span many items in one request, such as extracting structured data about all followers and exporting a CSV (gh-2). The project also pitches automating the web "at scale" from your own code (gh-3), and one community user reports bulk LinkedIn actions like sending friend requests (comm-5). There is no documented batch or bulk-operations feature, so the depth of this support is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented batch/parallel run API or bulk-action primitive, details on fan-out across many items or sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
